business_problem: Syngenta needed a better way to support AI-ready R&D data products for crop protection research because research data across dozens of countries and systems took months to access, which slowed scientific collaboration and product development.
solution_summary: Syngenta uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support AI-ready R&D data products for crop protection research. The implementation replaced a legacy state where research data across dozens of countries and systems took months to access, which slowed scientific collaboration and product development. Molecular research data and drone and satellite imagery move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver R&D data products and scientist self-service insights.
business_outcome: Syngenta improved AI-ready R&D data products for crop protection research with measurable results including 200 protecting crops today to feed billions tomorrow, 70% data products with more published every week, and 50% faster time to value, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
